2026-10-23IRCCCitizenship ActRegulations Amending the Citizenship Regulations (Administrative Penalties and Consequences) Regulations Amending the Citizenship Regulations (Administrative Penalties and Consequences) in order to (1) establish a new system of administrative penalties and consequences to address unauthorized practice and misrepresentation in immigration and citizenship services; (2) give Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada officers authority to investigate suspected violations, issue preliminary notices and notices of violations, and impose monetary penalties and consequences on individuals who engage in unauthorized practice or who misrepresent in immigration or citizenship services; and (3) require for the system to introduce clear penalties, a review process, and public disclosure of violators.Registration: SOR/2026-0221 Publication Date: 2026-11-04
subject: Regulations Amending the Citizenship Regulations (Administrative Penalties and Consequences)
precis: Regulations Amending the Citizenship Regulations (Administrative Penalties and Consequences) in order to (1) establish a new system of administrative penalties and consequences to address unauthorized practice and misrepresentation in immigration and citizenship services; (2) give Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada officers authority to investigate suspected violations, issue preliminary notices and notices of violations, and impose monetary penalties and consequences on individuals who engage in unauthorized practice or who misrepresent in immigration or citizenship services; and (3) require for the system to introduce clear penalties, a review process, and public disclosure of violators.
